fields.value: Approximately 101 bpm (conditional mean-interval estimate). The retained negative troughs are approximately evenly spaced. Regular similar mainly downward small complexes; tiny precomplex negative contour and flatter following component. The repeated small negative prefeatures permit a conditional junctional-pattern teaching comparison, not a preferred diagnosis. They must first be established as atrial waves with retrograde timing and compatible lead polarity; the course also requires a short PR when measurable and QRS below 0.12 s, neither established here. The conditional rate lies near the accelerated-junctional/junctional-tachycardia boundary, so no subtype is selected. PR remains withheld. The selected QRS uncertainty envelope crosses 0.12 s and does not establish a narrow/wide class.
